text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Today is an auspicious day.
Because—)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: (Because God says so!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Trainer, look at this.
This, this right here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! A tea leaf is standing upright!
A brave leaf that escaped the tea bag popped right up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What a good omen! I have a hunch about this.
Perhaps the fated day has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We can't just stand around. Let's head over to that place right away and receive a divine oracle!

The fortune-loving girl, Matikanefukukitaru,
dashes headlong toward "that place"...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
God, please tell me.
Is today 'the' day?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Show your will! Hongyaro,
fungyaro~. Kieeeeee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-And there it is, Great Blessing! Which means...
It's finally here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The gods proclaim: 'Today is the day
you must begin preparations
for the Twinkle Series!'

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The time to launch has finally arrived! The moon is in the east, the sun is in the west.
And as for me, it's time to Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm sure we'll be able
to repay Lady Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a veeery auspicious god
who only shows up in my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I remember it vividly; several years ago, I was hesitating.
Wondering whether or not I should enter Tracen Academy..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I have an exceptional older sister, so by comparison, I was completely useless.
But on that day, inside my dream...

text_block_list.name: Lady Shiraoki
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru, run.
And the path shall open before you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It was that divine revelation that guided me
to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: When I couldn't bring myself to run no matter what, Lady Shiraoki gave me courage, didn't she?
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, that's right.
Come to think of it, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer, I don't have
as much talent as my big sister. But...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nobody relies on luck more desperately than me!
In fact, that's all I've got! I just wanna ride on pure luck and snatch up all the good stuff!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this what everyone wishes for?
There's nothing wrong with conquering the
Twinkle Series purely on luck, right?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yay! As expected of my Trainer!
You totally get it, a true connoisseur of understanding!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well then, on this wonderful day, let's ring the bell and offer our prayers once again!
choice_data_list: May Matikanefukukitaru go on to achieve great things!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Then I'll pray too.
Please, oh please, God, Buddha, Shiraoki-sama~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Please make me happy~. I'll wait patiently, so pretty please, I'm begging you~!

Relying entirely on outside help to the very end...
Even so, Matikanefukukitaru's challenge had begun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
First is the Make Debut race.
Trainer, please pick a good race for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You're right. If possible, let's aim for a Taian day, an Ichiryumanbai-bi, a super lucky day, please!
